criteria.text: Calculates the long-stop date as 30 May 2027 (120 days after signing on 30 January 2027) and identifies that expected clearance on 29 June 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $2,400,000 (3 x ($7,300,000 - $6,500,000), subject to the $5,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $3,000,000 is wrong.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($1,400,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $2,400,000 and the Seller's $3,000,000.
Gives the long-stop period as 120 days and as the date 30 May 2027, with days remaining from 1 March 2027 (90 days).
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
